faq_heading: Homes near Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 428 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,539,166, townhomes $835,000, condos $555,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary the median was 20 days on the market, closing at 98.3% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 428 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Willoughby Elementary (0.6 km east), Peter Ewart Middle School (0.7 km west) and R E Mountain Secondary (0.8 km south-west).

How the Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 428 homes sold within 1 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary: 28 houses, 219 townhomes and 149 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $835,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Willoughby Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is des Voyageurs, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Willoughby Elementary (0.6 km east), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.9 km east), Josette Dandurand Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Lynn Fripps Elementary (1.3 km north-east), R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.7 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Willoughby Elementary, 0.6 km east of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary.
